description: One row for each trading day: the portfolio value at the close, new money put in, the day profit or loss from price moves, and the total profit. 9 Oct is the starting point. Dividends are not counted in the value; the 13 Nov row explains Seplat's ex-dividend drop. On 16 Nov 2026 the values for 9, 12, 13, 14 and 19 Oct, 28-30 Oct and 11 Nov were recalculated from NGX official closes (the earlier figures used broker snapshots taken before the close or carried-forward prices); each changed row's note gives the old figure. Day P/L moved accordingly, mainly between 12 Oct and 13 Oct.
schedule: Claude adds a row after each close when you ask for the day's update
title: Daily portfolio log
